name: Smartsheet
description: Monitor Smartsheet users and project sheets for compliance

config.setupInstructions:
Plan tier requirement:
The Smartsheet API is restricted to Business and Enterprise plans. Free and Pro accounts cannot use this integration — calls will fail with errorCode 1013 ('operation not supported by your plan').

Steps to generate a Smartsheet API access token:
1. In Smartsheet, click your Account icon (top-right) → Personal Settings → API Access
2. Click 'Generate new access token', name it (e.g. 'Comp AI compliance check'), and copy the value
3. Paste the token into the API Key field below

Permission requirements:
 - For the Employee Access check (lists users): the token must belong to a System Admin user with the ADMIN_USERS scope.
 - Tokens generated by non-admin users will fail with 403 even on Business/Enterprise plans.
 - If you regenerate the token in Smartsheet, paste the new value here — the old one is invalidated.
